**1 — Scene:** A meal of leafy salad, roasted skin-on squash, and two small rectangular pieces of tomato-topped pizza or focaccia.

**2 — Vessel:** Rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Using a circular-equivalent diameter of 28 cm gives an area of **3.14 × 14² ≈ 615 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Spinach/mixed leaves, shredded carrot, dried cranberries, seeds or chopped nuts, roasted squash, tomato-and-cheese pizza/focaccia, and a light coating of oil. The precise toppings and squash variety are uncertain.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Areas below partition the food footprint; oil coats existing food rather than occupying additional plate area.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density → weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Leafy greens | 26% | 160 × 2.5 = 400 ml | 0.15 → 60 g | 20 | 12 |
| Shredded carrot | 2% | 12 × 0.7 = 8.4 ml | 0.6 → 5 g | 41 | 2 |
| Dried cranberries | 3% | 18 × 1.0 = 18 ml | 0.65 → 12 g | 325 | 39 |
| Seeds/nut pieces | 2% | 12 × 0.5 = 6 ml | 0.65 → 4 g | 580 | 23 |
| Roasted squash | 21% | 129 × 2.2 = 284 ml | 0.6 → 170 g | 60 | 102 |
| Pizza/focaccia pieces | 21% | 129 × 1.5 = 194 ml | 0.9 → 174 g | 260 | 452 |
| Visible oil coating | Overlapping | Approximately 6.7 ml | 0.9 → 6 g | 884 | 53 |

**Area check:** 26 + 2 + 3 + 2 + 21 + 21 = **75% covered**, consistent with the empty lower-right portion of the plate.

**8 — Sanity check:** Estimated total is **431 g and approximately 685 kcal**. The greens contribute relatively little weight; the squash and bread-based pieces account for most of it. A reasonable uncertainty range is roughly **350–520 g and 550–850 kcal**, principally from bread thickness and oil content.
